Rating basis

This rating screens the decoded signal: substantial sustained full-scale samples or large DC offset rate Poor; overload risk, mono cancellation, dense dynamics or limited bandwidth rate Fair; no triggered rule rates High. Loudness, LRA, bitrate and format alone do not establish quality. Source clues are reported separately. This rating does not judge musical content or listening preference.
Loudness and true peak

Integrated loudness: %1$s LUFS
Loudness range: %2$s LU
True peak: %3$s dBTP
LUFS and LRA describe loudness and variation; larger or smaller is not intrinsically better.
Channels and DC offset

Left/right DC offset: %1$s%% / %2$s%%
DC-removed channel correlation: %3$s
Mid/side RMS: %4$s / %5$s dBFS
Correlation is not judged for mono, silence or zero-variance signals. Near 1 does not imply poor stereo.
Coverage and silence

Decoded: %1$s s; recorded duration: %2$s s
Near-silence (both channels ≤ −100 dBFS): %3$s%%
Longest continuous near-silence: %4$s s
Exact integer rail: %5$d frames / %6$d frames
Silence may be an intro, interlude or ending. Integer rails alone do not prove audible clipping.
